question.text: SEBI's quarterly AIF reports (non-leverage) must be filed within how many calendar days from quarter-end?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular April 7, 2021, periodical reports to SEBI by non-leveraged Cat III AIFs are due within 10 calendar days from end of each quarter (revised format). The Trap: 5/15/30 days are not the prescribed 10-day timeline. Cross-Exam Context: Cat I/II (XIX-A) follow the same 10-day cadence. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Treat the 10-day SEBI filing as a hard deadline — no grace period, and missed filings attract penalty.
